plain: The app must be finished and working when the reviewer opens it.
usuallyMeans: The reviewer hit a crash, a blank screen, placeholder text, a dead button, or could not sign in.
whatToDo: Open the app as a new user on a phone and press everything; give the reviewer a demo account.

appleCallsIt: Legal: Privacy: Data Collection and Storage
plain: The app needs a privacy policy that people can open from inside the app.
usuallyMeans: The reviewer could not find a privacy policy link in the app.
whatToDo: Add a privacy policy page and link it from the sign-up screen and the settings.

plain: If people can create an account in the app, they must be able to delete it in the app.
usuallyMeans: The reviewer created an account and found no way to delete it.
whatToDo: Add a Delete account option in the settings that really deletes the account.

plain: An app that offers sign-in with another company must also offer an equally private option, such as Sign in with Apple.
usuallyMeans: The sign-in screen had Google or Facebook login and no Apple option.
whatToDo: Add Sign in with Apple next to the other sign-in buttons.

plain: Digital goods and subscriptions used in the app must be sold through Apple's in-app purchase.
usuallyMeans: The reviewer found a link or button that sells a paid plan through an outside checkout.
whatToDo: Hide the outside checkout inside the iPhone app or add in-app purchase.

plain: Screenshots must show the app in use on that device.
usuallyMeans: The screenshots were marketing images, or iPhone screenshots stretched to iPad size.
whatToDo: Take real screenshots on each device size you list.
